third_party_evaluations.summary: Entry/practitioner-level pentest exam at Pearson VUE; recognised by UK NCSC CHECK.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded one-year practitioner profile and recognized examination support associate testing knowledge; UK-specific recognition alone does not establish senior competence for Japanese enterprise engagements.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded practitioner-level pentest scope, proctoring and a one-year profile support an associate hiring signal. NCSC-linked recognition is useful, but the evidence does not establish independent hands-on engagement delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded one-year practitioner scope and NCSC CHECK recognition support an associate offensive foundation. The evidence does not specify a hands-on delivery examination sufficient for professional placement.
